articles.title: CBI arrests student who received physics questions from Pune school headmistress in NEET-UG paper leak case
articles.summary: The CBI has arrested a student in connection with the ongoing NEET-UG paper leak case. The student reportedly received physics questions from a Pune school headmistress, highlighting a significant breach of examination integrity. This arrest is part of a broader investigation to ensure fairness in national entrance examinations, a crucial issue for aspiring professionals and national academic standards.

articles.title: Lincoln Avenue Communities Hosts Grand Opening Ceremony for Affordable Housing Development in San Antonio, Texas
articles.summary: A mission-driven company is developing 308 high-quality, affordable homes for individuals and families in San Antonio, Texas. Slated for completion around May 2026, this project aims to address housing needs within the community, offering crucial support for low to middle-income residents. This initiative highlights ongoing efforts to expand accessible living options.

articles.title: Finmin pushes for wider local sourcing norm in incentive schemes
articles.summary: The Finance Ministry is instructing other government ministries to integrate domestic manufacturing and procurement requirements into all incentive and subsidy schemes before seeking expenditure approval. This strategic directive aims to boost indigenous production, promote self-reliance under initiatives like 'Make in India,' and ensure government spending prioritizes local industries. It's a significant policy push to strengthen the national economy and reduce reliance on imports across various sectors.
